t: Proclaimed by Mao Zedong on 1 October 1949 after the Communist victory in the Chinese Civil War.
The Great Leap Forward famine and the Cultural Revolution were among the greatest human catastrophes of the century.
Deng Xiaoping’s reforms from 1978 combined market economics with one-party rule and made China a global economic power.
dyk: Hanyu Pinyin, the romanisation now used worldwide to spell Chinese names, was adopted by the People’s Republic in 1958.
ev: Mao Zedong proclaims the People’s Republic in Beijing on 1 October
Chinese People’s Volunteers enter the Korean War
The Great Leap Forward begins, leading to the famine of 1959–61
The People’s Republic takes China’s seat at the United Nations
Deng Xiaoping launches reform and opening
The army crushes the Tiananmen Square protests on 4 June
China joins the World Trade Organization
